Distinguished delegates, it is my pleasure to inform you about the work of the Working Group on the Status and Application of the 5 United Nations Treaties on Outer Space under Agenda Item 5. at the current session of this legal subcommittee. The working group focused on the exchange of views on the implementation of Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty in accordance with its work plan as contained in UN Document A/79/20, Annex 2. Under this work plan, the working group continued its exchange of views on the implementation of Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty and initiated the preparation of a template that could be offered to states and international intergovernmental organizations as a voluntary tool in accordance with its work plan. To enhance the working group discussion, 2 documents were prepared in advance of the subcommittee, namely the summary by the chair contained in document A/AC.105/C.2 Comprising the summary of last year's exchange of views, as well as a background paper prepared by the Secretariat at the request of the Working Group concerning the implementation of Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty and Article 4 of the Registration Convention, and contained in document A/AC.105/C.2/2011. The Working Group used a set of discussion questions proposed by the chair of the Working Group in an informal information circular dated 17th April 2025 to structure its work. And as an outcome, the Working Group agreed that the template under development should be suitable to accommodate the sharing of information on all types of space activities, regardless of whether they are planned, ongoing, or have been completed, and that the elements of Article 11 of the Outer Space Treaty should inform its structure. The working group also noted that the draft template, which will be presented by the chair of the working group in all official languages of the United Nations for consideration by the 65th session of the subcommittee, could be prepared based on the discussions at this session stimulated by a non-paper by the chair. Furthermore, the working group agreed to suspend the development of the schematic overview of national regulatory frameworks for space activities on the understanding that the working group could revisit it while the information of national regulatory frameworks will be kept updated under the database maintained by the office. Chair, the report of the working group as it has just been adopted is contained in document A/AC.105/C.2/TRE/2025/L.1. It is my pleasure to submit this report to the subcommittee for its action.
